blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines may import 5.7 million metric tons (MT) of rice next year to build buffer stocks against drought and monsoon risks, anticipating a production shortage. The US Department of Agriculture’s Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS) has raised its import forecast for the Philippines, noting that storms, monsoon rains, and the developing El Niño could impact domestic rice output and elevate retail prices.
